svg.aria-label: No. 001. local-fitness. Agent-first fitness coach. Pulls Garmin data into a local SQLite database and exposes deterministic training-load math (CTL / ATL / TSB) to Claude over MCP. Built with Python, MCP, SQLite, Flask.
